Cornucopias Family,


 $COPI staking on the VyFi platform has been super successful - big Thank You to all who have participated. We've been listening to your feedback, and as a result, we've decided to increase the APR for our community!

 Effective immediately, we're excited to offer a higher APR of 3.87% for staking $COPI on the VyFi platform. To take advantage of this opportunity, simply visit https://app.vyfi.io/vaults/copi and stake your $COPI. We encourage you to move your $COPI from the old vault to the new one so that you can continue earning $COPI rewards.
